kpis.name: Turnovers
kpis.description: Number of times that a team lost the possession of the ball in open play per match.

kpis.name: Turnover line height (m)
kpis.description: Average height on the pitch that a team lost the possession of the ball in open play per match.

kpis.name: Recoveries within 5s %
kpis.description: Percentage of ball recoveries made by a team within 5 seconds after losing the possession of the ball in open play per match.

kpis.name: Time to defensive action (s)
kpis.description: Average time that it took a team to make a defensive action after losing the possession of the ball in open play per match.

kpis.name: Time to recovery (s)
kpis.description: Average time that it took a team to recover the possession of the ball after losing it in open play per match.

kpis.name: Opp. Possessions to final third within 10s after recovery
kpis.description: Number of possessions of the opposing team that successfully reached the final third within 10 seconds after an open play ball recovery per match.
kpis.display_name: Opp. Possessions to final third within 10s after recovery

kpis.name: Opp. Possessions to box within 10s after recovery
kpis.description: Number of possessions of the opposing team that entered the penalty area following an open play ball recovery per matcb.
kpis.display_name: Opp. Possessions to box within 10s after recovery

kpis.name: Opp. xT within 10s after recovery
kpis.description: Expected offensive contribution by the opposing team considering the quality of their actions within 10 seconds after an open play ball recovery per match.

kpis.name: Opp. xG within 10s after recovery
kpis.description: Number of goals that the opposing team should be expected to score statistically considering the quality of their chances from attacks following an open play ball recovery per match.
